{"code": "import pandas as pd

# We have df_treatment: 253 patients in treatment arm, deduplicated and baseline valid

# Check distribution of sex and severity in treatment arm
treatment_sex_severity = pd.crosstab(df_treatment['sex'], df_treatment['severity'])
print("Cross-tab of sex vs severity in treatment arm:")
print(treatment_sex_severity)

# Compute response rates by sex in treatment arm
treatment_response_by_sex = df_treatment.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by sex in treatment arm:")
print(treatment_response_by_sex)

# Compute the difference in response rates (F - M)
diff_response_rate = treatment_response_by_sex['F'] - treatment_response_by_sex['M']
print(f"\nDifference in response rates (F - M): {diff_response_rate:.4f}")

# Also check the raw counts for clarity
response_counts = df_treatment.groupby(['sex', 'responded']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nResponse counts by sex:")
print(response_counts)"}
